name: LoyaltyX – Points and Rewards for WooCommerce
author: DevDiggers

sections.description:
LoyaltyX – Points and Rewards for WooCommerce is a comprehensive customer loyalty plugin that rewards customers with points for purchases and activities. Customers can redeem points for discounts, free products, and special rewards, creating an incentive system that drives repeat purchases and engagement.

Why Choose LoyaltyX?

  • Easy Setup: Get started in minutes with our intuitive dashboard.
  • Flexible Points System: Customize earning and redemption rates to fit your business.
  • Customer Engagement: Keep customers coming back with rewarding experiences.
  • Performance Optimized: Built for speed with efficient database queries.
  • Developer Friendly: Extensive hooks and filters for customization.
  • SEO Optimized: Improve search rankings with customer engagement features.
  • Mobile Responsive: Works perfectly on all devices.
  • GDPR Compliant: Respects user privacy and data protection.

FREE VERSION FEATURES

Points Earning

  • Purchase Amount – Reward customers with points based on order total
  • Flexible Conversion Rates – Set custom earning rates (e.g., $1 = 10 points)

Points Redemption

  • Points to Store Credit – Convert points into coupon value for future purchases
  • Automatic Redemption – Seamless checkout experience with point redemption

Points Management

  • Manual Point Adjustments – Add or deduct points with detailed notes
  • Points History Tracking – Complete transaction logs for all customers
  • Point Labels – Customize singular/plural point labels to match your brand

Customer Dashboard

  • Points Balance Display – Real-time points balance for customers
  • Transaction History – Detailed view of earned and redeemed points
  • Points Details – Visual breakdown with icons and statistics

Admin Features

  • User Points Management – View and manage customer points from admin
  • Import Tools – Bulk import customer points via CSV
  • Email Notifications – Customizable email templates for point activities
  • Comprehensive Reporting – Track points earning, redemption, and usage

Technical Features

  • HPOS Compatible – Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Shortcode Support – Display points information anywhere on your site
  • [ddwcpr_points_dashboard] – Complete customer points dashboard
  • [ddwcpr_available_points_value] – Show current points balance
  • Multilingual Ready – Translation-ready with included .pot file
  • Background Processing – Efficient handling of point calculations
  • Ajax Powered – Real-time updates without page refreshes

PREMIUM VERSION FEATURES

Upgrade to LoyaltyX Pro to unlock advanced features and maximize customer loyalty:

Advanced Points Earning

  • Product Purchase Rewards – Bonus points for specific products
  • Category Purchase Rewards – Points for purchasing from specific categories
  • User Role Bonuses – Different earning rates based on user roles
  • Referral Program – Reward customers for bringing new customers
  • Signup Bonuses – Points for new account creation
  • Review Rewards – Points for submitting product reviews
  • Daily Login Rewards – Daily engagement incentives
  • Birthday Points – Special rewards on customer birthdays
  • Level-Up Bonuses – Additional points for reaching loyalty tiers

Advanced Redemption Options

  • Fixed Amount Discounts – Preset discount amounts (e.g., 500 points = $50 off)
  • Percentage Discounts – Percentage-based discount coupons
  • Buy X Get Y Deals – Special product bundles with points
  • Free Shipping – Redeem points for free shipping
  • Free Products – Exchange points for free items

Advanced Management

  • Points Expiration – Set expiration periods with email reminders
  • Customer Levels/Tiers – VIP programs with different earning rates
  • Referral Tracking – Complete referral system with unique links
  • Advanced Analytics – Detailed reporting and insights
  • Bulk Point Operations – Mass point adjustments and management
  • Export Tools – Bulk export customer points data via CSV

Enhanced Features

  • My Account Integration – Dedicated loyalty section in customer accounts
  • Advanced Email Templates – Branded notifications with personalization
  • Advanced Styling Options – Custom themes and branding
  • Priority Support – Direct access to our expert support team
  • White Label Options – Remove branding for agency use
  • Advanced User Segmentation – Target specific customer groups
  • Automated Campaigns – Scheduled point rewards and promotions

  • GDPR Compliant: Respects user privacy and data protection.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “LoyaltyX – WooCommerce Points and Rewards”.
  3. Click Install Now then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate through Plugins menu.

After Installation

  1. Navigate to DevDiggers Plugins > LoyaltyX in admin menu.
  2. Run the setup wizard to configure basic settings.
  3. Set up earning and redemption rules.
  4. Customize point labels and messages.
  5. Configure email notifications.
  6. Launch your loyalty program!
sections.faq:
How do customers earn points?

Customers earn points automatically for purchases based on your configured conversion rate (e.g., $1 = 10 points). With the premium version, they can also earn points for referrals, reviews, signups, and other activities.

How do customers redeem points?

Customers can redeem points for discount coupons during checkout. The free version supports converting points to store credit. Premium version adds fixed discounts, percentage discounts, free shipping, and free products.

Do points expire?

Points expiration is available in the premium version. You can set expiration periods and send reminder emails before points expire.

Can I import existing customer points?

Yes! Use the Import feature to bulk import customer points via CSV. This is perfect for migrating from another loyalty system.

Are points refunded on order cancellation?

Yes, points are automatically deducted when orders are cancelled, failed, or refunded to maintain accurate point balances.

Can I customize point labels?

Absolutely! Change “Points” to “Credits”, “Rewards”, or any term that fits your brand.

Is LoyaltyX compatible with my theme?

LoyaltyX is designed to work with any WordPress theme. It follows WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards for maximum compatibility.

Can I run multiple loyalty programs?

The premium version supports advanced rules and conditions, allowing you to create different programs for different customer segments.

How does the referral program work?

In the premium version, customers get unique referral links. When someone makes a purchase using their link, both the referrer and referee earn points.

What payment gateways are supported?

LoyaltyX works with any WooCommerce-compatible payment gateway. Points are awarded after successful payment processing.

Can I restrict points to certain products?

Yes! In the premium version, you can set rules for specific products, categories, or customer groups.

How do I track customer points?

View all customer points from the admin dashboard. Track earning/redemption history and generate reports.

Is there a limit to the number of customers?

No limits! LoyaltyX scales with your business growth.

Can I send custom emails to customers?

Yes, customize email templates for all point-related notifications.

What if I need help setting up LoyaltyX?

Our support team is here to help! Visit our documentation or contact support for assistance.

Can I translate LoyaltyX to my language?

Yes, LoyaltyX is translation-ready.

How does LoyaltyX improve customer retention?

LoyaltyX creates an incentive system that encourages repeat purchases through points rewards, increasing customer lifetime value and engagement.

Is LoyaltyX GDPR compliant?

Yes, LoyaltyX follows GDPR guidelines and respects user privacy. All customer data is handled securely.

How does LoyaltyX affect site performance?

LoyaltyX is optimized for performance with efficient database queries and minimal impact on page load times.

Does LoyaltyX support variable products?

Yes, LoyaltyX works with all WooCommerce product types including simple, variable, grouped, and external products.

Can customers see their points history?

Yes, customers can view their complete points transaction history in their account dashboard.

Is LoyaltyX mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The customer dashboard and all features are fully responsive and work perfectly on mobile devices.

How often are points calculated?

Points are calculated in real-time during the order process and updated immediately after successful payment.

How do I migrate from another loyalty plugin?

Use the CSV import feature to bulk import existing customer points data from other loyalty plugins.

Can I create custom earning rules?

The premium version offers extensive customization options for creating complex earning rules.

Is there a free trial available?

The free version includes all basic features. Try it risk-free to see how it works for your store!

How do I get started with LoyaltyX?

Simply install the plugin, configure your earning rates and start rewarding customers immediately!
